mechanism: A later reviewer returns a declaration that an earlier reviewer approved
measures: Share of later-step decisions that are rejections when the previous event was an approval
estimable_note: Observed disagreement rate between sequential steps. Says nothing about who was right.
conditions: Eindhoven University of Technology travel expense declarations (domestic), 2017 two departments, 2018 whole university; staff anonymised to roles
transfer: Weak. Shows sequential reviewers disagree at a low observed rate.

source.name: BPI Challenge 2020: Domestic Declarations
source.creator: Boudewijn van Dongen, Eindhoven University of Technology
